terms.gloss: bring or put close to, lean against, join to; sē applicāre ad, attach oneself to
evidence: Cic. Verr. 2.2.2: Sicilia sē ad amīcitiam fidemque populī Rōmānī applicāvit (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: ut vītēs arboribus applicitae īnferiōrēs prius apprehendendō rāmōs in cacūmina ēvādunt
phrases.english: as vines trained against trees get to the top by first taking hold of the lower branches

sources: Bennett: hidden quantities, with later corrections
